generalAbilities.name: Effigy Identity
generalAbilities.description: While a flayer leech is in an effigy, it gains the ability to understand and speak all languages known by the corpse as well as knowledge of the corpse's physical abilities, identity, role in society, and personality. However, it doesn't gain the specific memories or knowledge of the corpse.

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 5 (deactivated by acid or sonic)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Light Blindness
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

When first exposed to bright light, the monster is Blinded until the end of its next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind the monster again until after it spends 1 hour in darkness. However, as long as the monster is in an area of bright light, it's Dazzled.

offensiveAbilities.name: Create Effigy
offensiveAbilities.description: A flayer leech consumes the brain of the corpse of a Medium or Small creature dead for no longer than an hour, taking over its body. It also stitches together any wounds the corpse might have, presenting only barely visible lines. It can use Stealth to Impersonate skill=stealth and doesn't need a disguise kit to do so, but it takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the check if any creature engages the flayer leech in conversation for 1 minute. When in this effigy form, it loses its weakness to bludgeoning and gains weakness 5 to sonic damage. It can make proboscis melee Strikes through extension in its wrists, but it can't make subsonic blast ranged Strikes. A flayer leech can Dismiss the effigy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drink Marrow
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The flayer leech's last action was a successful proboscis Strike against a living creature

Effect The flayer leech vibrates its proboscis at subsonic speed, drilling into a creature's marrow or equivalent bone structure. The required creature must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw or become Sickened 1. On a critical failure, it can't reduce this sickened condition for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mandible Dance
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The flayer leech isn't currently in an effigy

Effect The flayer leech wriggles its facial tendrils in a tantalizing way. Each creature within 30 feet that can see the flayer leech must attempt a DC 21 Will Saving Throw saving throw or be Fascinated by the flayer leech for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Warp Bones
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The flayer leech is in an effigy

Effect s The flayer leech has a link to any marrow it's tasted. It sends out subsonic waves to vibrate its enemies' skeletal structures, causing immense pain. Any creature within 40 feet with the sickened condition from the flayer leech's Drink Marrow ability takes 3d8 Sonic Damage damage (Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
